items.text: The merge check sends a changed evidence helper outside its caller’s directory for review. Exercise this in a disposable fixture alongside a normal unchanged helper. Run scripts/plan-test.
An unverified note cannot establish a trusted pass. Keep the clean merge-commit rerun authoritative. Cover ordinary verifier output and the trust boundary in scripts/plan-test.

Resume a failed node from the committed plan in a fresh workflow run. Its previous rounds still count toward three, including across repeated restarts. A different node retains its own budget. Run scripts/run-plan-test.
